name: Infiltrator’s Welcome
body:
School illusion; Level bard 3, sorcerer/wizard 3
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute/level

Upon completing the spell you become invisible as per the invisibility spell and you gain a +5 insight bonus on Disable Device checks and Perception checks to find traps. If you perform an action that would end the invisibility effect, like performing an offensive action, you lose the bonuses to your skill checks as well.
